lines:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Client
    participant Core
    participant Adapter
    participant Desktop
    Client->>Core: typed mutation with operation ID and resource guards
    Core->>Core: validate inputs and request fingerprint
    Core->>Adapter: begin atomic unit
    Adapter->>Adapter: check durable receipt inside transaction
    alt identical retry
        Adapter-->>Core: original committed result
    else new operation
        Adapter->>Adapter: compare guards and validate dependencies
        Adapter->>Adapter: apply changes or roll back all
        Adapter->>Adapter: persist receipt and changed resource versions
        Adapter->>Adapter: commit with content cursor
        Adapter-->>Core: committed result and cursor
    end
    Core-->>Client: typed result or precise conflict
    Desktop->>Core: compare opaque change cursor
    Core-->>Desktop: refresh committed state while preserving drafts
